preconditions.description: The number of cards n must be between 1 and 100.
The required total power k must be between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= pi <= 1000 and 1 <= ci <= 100000 and 1 <= li <= n for pi, ci, li in cards)
preconditions.description: Each card's power, magic number, and level must be within specified bounds.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not can_build_deck else stdout == str(min_level)
postconditions.description: If a deck cannot be built, output -1; otherwise, output the minimum level required.
A deck can be built if the total power of selected cards is at least k.

postconditions.expression: min_level == max(li for pi, ci, li in selected_cards)
postconditions.description: The minimum level required is the maximum level of the selected cards.
